## Outcome

What materially changes for the person using Drift?

## Evidence

- [ ] `npm run check`, or the reason it was not run is stated below
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` when browser behaviour changed
- [ ] Native source/build/verifier evidence when macOS, bridge, packaging, entitlement, or codec behaviour changed
- [ ] Decoded artifact evidence when export changed
- [ ] Synthetic or publication-safe visual evidence when appearance changed

## Contract checks

Mark non-applicable items `N/A` in the boundaries section.

- [ ] Native commands, file authority, sandbox, network, cancellation, and cleanup boundaries were reviewed
- [ ] Dependencies, bundled assets, licences, notices, exact runtime licence texts, and SBOM impact were reviewed
- [ ] Project schema, engine/theme versions, native bridge version, package/app version, and minimum macOS were deliberately preserved or updated
- [ ] Status, changelog, product, security, and release documentation changed where the public claim changed
- [ ] A local build or CI artifact is not described as merged, released, notarized, or published

## Boundaries

What remains intentionally out of scope or unverified? Confirm that no private deck, video, project bundle, token, or client render is included.
